overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by email: a member's reply to a resident's message that copied the whole Board concerned a matter within the Board's jurisdiction. The AG ordered the email released publicly within 30 days and reminded the Board to avoid substantive email exchanges among members.

allegations.summary: Alleged that a board member's email reply to a resident's message, which copied the full board, was deliberation by email about the Charter Review Committee.
allegations.key_passage: Similar to OML 2017-140, we conclude that Mr. Hakansson's email concerned a matter within the Board's jurisdiction, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Disclose the board member's email to the public within 30 days of receipt of the determination, if not already done.
remedy_passage: As a remedial measure, we order the Board to disclose Mr. Hakannson's email to the public within 30 days of receipt of this determination, if it has not done so already.
